notes.title: Name Change, Demo Update & Upcoming Play Test
notes.content:
[b]What's In a Name?[/b]

As you may have seen on the Store page, the game has a new name. Fealty! 

The name change is for a few reasons, but mainly we didn't think the old name reflected what the game is. We did not want to assume a storyline for the game and the old name seemed to suggest that there was one. It's a strategy game, pure and simple, and we think the new name reflects that better.

We have updated the demo to include the name change and other fixes/changes. 

[b]Multiplayer Play Test[/b]

We will be announcing the multiplayer play test here on Steam soon. So please be on the lookout for that. The game has a decent AI that is fun to play against in solo play, but there is something special about playing with and against others that we can't wait for you to experience.

Have a great day!

Todd

notes.title: Demo Update 0.91.1
notes.content:
We just released a small update to the demo that addresses a few minor issues with the demo.

Mainly, the primary fix was that the arrow would not point at the proper UI element unless you were running the game in a 16:9 aspect ratio.  This has been corrected so it should point properly in any aspect ratio now.

We also addressed a graphical issue that made the whole game look grainy in some cases.

Beyond that, there were just a few minor changes to some text to make the tutorial a bit better.

Enjoy!
